def node.ApplyConfChange.dynamicSpec : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Loc) (γ : Cluster) (N : Namespace) (id : w64) (c0 : Membership) (decode : ConfChangeDecoder) (c : GoInterface)
    (o o' : ConfChangeIM) (l : List LogEntry) (k : Nat) (e : LogEntry) (v : ConfigView) (m' : Membership),
    v.applied ≤ k →
      l[k]? = some e →
        e.isConfChange →
          NoConfChangeIn l v.applied k →
            decode (List.take k l) e = some o' →
              Membership.applyChange o' v.membership = some m' →
                Membership.applyChange o v.membership = some m' →
                  ⊢
                    ∀ Φ,
                      isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
                          isNode n γ N id ∗
                            isDynamicCluster γ N c0 decode ∗
                              ownConfChangeI c DFrac.discard (some o) ∗ nodeConfig n γ N v ∗ deliveredLogLb n γ N l -∗
                        (▷
                            ∀ csp cs,
                              csPts csp (DFrac.own 1) cs true ∗
                                    nodeConfig n γ N { applied := k + 1, membership := m' } ∗ ⌜confStateIs cs m'⌝ ∨
                                  ⌜csp = null⌝ ∗ nodeStopped n γ N -∗
                                Φ (intoVal csp)) -∗
                          WP
                            ((intoVal
                                (methods node.ty.PointerType
                                  go!"ApplyConfChange"
